description: Creates a complete, ready-to-use map event at (x, y) from a template, in one write. Refuses out-of-bounds tiles, and refuses a tile that already holds an event unless allowStack is true. Graphics default to none: events are INVISIBLE in game until an image is supplied (chest: closedImage/openImage, npc: image; locked_door, inn, shop and save_point never get a graphic and are meant to sit on a tile that already looks right). Templates and their params: chest {reward: {gold?, item?: {type: item|weapon|armor, id, count?}}, message?, closedImage?, openImage?} (two pages: the action button opens it and sets self switch A, then an empty opened page; if only closedImage is given, openImage defaults to the same graphic with direction 8 - the opened-chest frame of the standard chest sheets); locked_door {keyItemId, destination: {mapId, x, y, direction?: 0|2|4|6|8}, lockedMessage?, consumeKey?} (transfers the player if the party holds the key); inn {price, greeting?} (Stay/Leave choice; staying charges gold, fades out, restores the party, fades in); shop {goods: [{type: item|weapon|armor, id, price?}] (1-40; price defaults to the database price), purchaseOnly?}; save_point {} (opens the save screen); npc {lines: string[], face?: {name, index}, image?}. Image = {characterName, characterIndex (0-7), direction?: 2|4|6|8, pattern?: 0|1|2}. Returns { eventId, name, pages }.

allowStack.description: Allow placing the event on a tile that already has an event

characterIndex.description: Which of the 8 characters on the sheet (0-7)

characterName.description: Character sheet name in img/characters, e.g. "People1" or "!Chest"

consumeKey.description: locked_door: remove one key on use

goods.description: shop: 1-40 entries { type: item|weapon|armor, id, price? }; omit price for the database price

keyItemId.description: locked_door: item id of the key

lines.description: npc: lines of dialogue (4 per message box)

lockedMessage.description: locked_door: text when the player has no key (default "It's locked.")

message.description: chest: text shown when opened (default "You found treasure!")

name.description: Event name; defaults to the template name (Chest, Door, Inn, Shop, Save Point, NPC)

openImage.description: chest: graphic after opening (default: closedImage facing up)

reward.description: chest: { gold?: number, item?: {type: item|weapon|armor, id, count?} }, at least one

template.description: Which template to build; the other fields depend on it

name: create_event_from_template
title: Create event from template
